name: AddUserModal
description: Modal form for inviting a new user — captures email, role, and optional team assignment

props.name: open
props.description: Controls whether the dialog is visible

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called when the user dismisses the modal (cancel or backdrop)

props.name: roles
props.description: List of assignable roles rendered in the role select drop-down

props.name: onSubmit
props.type: (data: { name: string; email: string; role: string }) => Promise<void>
props.description: Async handler called with validated form values on submission

props.name: isSubmitting
props.description: Disables the submit button and shows a loading label while the parent is saving
